name: @pipeworx/mcp-poshmark-comps

tools.name: poshmark_sold_search
tools.description: Search Poshmark SOLD listings and return realized/ask-at-sale prices — the best open sold-price comp data on Poshmark (no login, no API key). Sourced live from poshmark.com/search?availability=sold_out. Returns up to ~48 results per call (one page, no pagination cursor). `price` is the listing price shown on the sold post, as Poshmark reports it — not an independently verified receipt.

query.description: Search text, e.g. "lululemon align leggings" or "coach tabby bag"

department.description: Optional department filter as Poshmark spells it, e.g. "Women", "Men", "Kids", "Home"

tools.name: poshmark_active_search
tools.description: Search Poshmark ACTIVE (currently listed, not yet sold) listings — for comparing current ask prices against poshmark_sold_search results. No login, no API key. Returns up to ~48 results per call.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-poshmark-comps forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the poshmark-comps pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
